### ① Derived judgments

**`@object-ui/fields` — published surface (`exports["."]` → `dist/index.d.ts`, the barrel is `src/index.tsx`).**

- `FileValueView.metadataRefused?: true` — RIGHT. `src/widgets/file-value.ts` is re-exported by the barrel (`export * from './widgets/file-value.js'`), so the new optional member IS published. It is additive (optional, set only on the refused marker), and the PR's `Clause-②: yes` names exactly it.
- `RestrictedFileAffordance`, `useRestrictedFileText` (new exports of `src/widgets/file-affordance.tsx`) — RIGHT, not published. The barrel only *imports* from `./widgets/file-affordance.js` (line 369, `import { FileValueAffordance, RestrictedFileAffordance }`); there is no `export * from` or `export {}` for that module, and none of the re-exported widgets (`FileField.tsx`, `ImageField.tsx`, `AvatarField.tsx`) re-export them either — each only imports. The declaration closure cannot reach them: `file-value.ts` uses `isFileRefusedValue` only inside a function body, so the emitted `file-value.d.ts` carries no import of `./file-refused.js`.
- `isFileRefusedValue`, `fileValueForResubmit` (`src/widgets/file-refused.ts`, new) — RIGHT, not published; the module is absent from the barrel and is imported only by `file-value.ts`, `FileField.tsx`, `ImageField.tsx`.
- Accept-set of `readFileValue` — RIGHT. The marker is recognised through the spec's closed `FileRefusedValueSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, resolvable at the head's `^18.0.0-next.0`), so `{ id, metadataRefused: true }` and nothing wider: an object with any extra key, or `metadataRefused: false`, still reads through the ordinary object arm as before (pinned). For the marker the only observable difference against base is the added flag: `id`, the id-derived `url`, the fallback `name` and the absent `mimeType` are what the object arm already produced.
- Re-submit path — RIGHT. `fileValueForResubmit` reduces the marker to its bare id on append / remove / crop in `FileField`, `FileCell`, `ImageField`, and leaves every other element untouched (`images.map(...)` keeps length, so the crop index stays aligned). This is the card's "submits only the bare id, never the marker object".
- Render behaviour — RIGHT and within the ask: `FileValueAffordance` routes a restricted view to `RestrictedFileAffordance` (lock + translated label, still an anchor to the id-derived endpoint, hint on `title`); `FileCellRenderer`, `FileField` list and rows, `FileCell`, `ImageField` (read-only and editable, no lightbox entry, no crop button), `ImageCellRenderer`, `AvatarField` never attempt a thumbnail for it. `ImageCellRenderer` / `ImageField` read-only: a value holding only refused images is no longer `EmptyValue` — a render change, not a type or export change, and it is the state the card asks for. `AvatarField` draws a lock with no link because it never had an open affordance; the card's "affordance stays" item is satisfied wherever an affordance exists.
- `data-slot="file-restricted"` is a new DOM hook; it is not a package export and is declared nowhere as contract — acceptable.

**`@object-ui/i18n` — published surface (`exports["."]`, `./locales`, `./locales/*`).**

- `fields.file.restricted`, `fields.file.restrictedHint` in all ten packs — RIGHT, and they ARE published: the entry exports `en` and `type TranslationKeys = typeof en` (`as const`), and `./locales` + `./locales/*` export every pack. `TranslationKeys` therefore widens by two keys. It is an output type only: `I18nConfig.resources` is typed as a plain record of unknown values, not as `TranslationKeys`, so no consumer input is narrowed — additive. The PR body declares this ("the exported locale packs gain two keys"); the dev's Clause-② paragraph is complete for both packages.

The one `failure`, `Spec Main Shape Gate` (`115711492443`), is the base's: its 21 annotations, read from the annotations endpoint, sit on `.github` (11), `packages/core/src/adapters/resolveDataSource.ts` (6) and `packages/react/src/hooks/useViewData.ts` (4) — none on a file this PR touches, message "compiled against @objectstack/spec built from objectstack-ai/objectstack@e4ec6ec1a5ef" — and `main`'s scheduled run `38513810543` at `c08c9332a6` fails the same way. Not attributable to this head.

The diff publishes a widening in each package (an optional member on an exported interface; two keys on exported packs and on `TranslationKeys`) and nothing narrowing or removed, so `minor` is the floor and the ceiling; `skip-changeset` would have been wrong.
